hot_themes: Overthinking and anxiety in everyday situations
Gen Z workplace struggles and remote work dynamics
Psychological value, status, and wealth perception
hook_patterns: Direct POV addressing: 'You are a Gen Z working 9 to 5...'
Extreme exaggerations of universal cognitive flaws (e.g., overthinking taken to absurd levels)
Counter-intuitive facts/tricks: 'The secret trick X doesn't want you to know'
ideas_for_us: Friend A spiraling into an existential crisis over a 'k' text message, while Friend B uses cognitive behavioral therapy tricks to map out his absurd overthinking.
Friend A tries to act 'mysterious and high-value' at a house party based on a psychology article, but Friend B keeps exposing the pathetic reality behind his tactics.
Friend A complains about working from home in his pajamas, so Friend B explains the 'Enclothed Cognition' effect by forcing him into a hilarious mock-corporate routine.
Friend B explains the famous Baker-Baker Paradox to explain why Friend A can remember useless video game lore perfectly but constantly forgets his own girlfriend's name.
